onboarding.desc: Complete these basic steps to get the most out of the system.
onboarding.done: Great job! You're all set to use the system.

guide.modalDesc: Select a section below to read its detailed instructions:

pos.title: End of Day & Shifts (EOD)
pos.content:
🎯 Purpose:
The financial heart of the store. Allows the manager to monitor cashiers, force-close shifts, and archive daily sales securely to prevent fraud.

⚙️ Detailed Steps:
• Live Shifts: View who is currently working, their check-in time, and live sales.
• Close Shift: Usually done by the cashier, but the admin can force-close it. Requires entering the 'Actual Cash' counted in the drawer.
• Z-Report: The most crucial daily action. Closes the business day, archives all shifts and financial data, and resets drawers for the next day.
• Archive: Access past days to reprint Z-Reports in detailed A4 format or thermal receipt format.

hr.title: HR & Employee Badges
hr.content:
🎯 Purpose:
Total control over your workforce. Track exact attendance for accurate payroll, issue secure access badges, and define system permissions.

⚙️ Detailed Steps:
• Add Employee: Go to 'Employees' tab, click 'Add'. Assign a name, role (determines their access level), and a unique PIN.
• Issue Badge: Click 'Employee Badge', enter the PIN, and the system generates a printable barcode ID card.
• Attendance: Employees scan their barcode to log check-in and check-out times.
• Edit Time: If an employee forgets to check out, admins can click the edit icon in the attendance log to correct the time manually.

payroll.title: Payroll Calculator
payroll.content:
🎯 Purpose:
Automates monthly salary calculations. Eliminates manual math by aggregating working hours and automatically deducting taken advances.

⚙️ Detailed Steps:
• Calculate: Select an employee, set the date range and hourly rate. The system calculates the 'Gross Salary'.
• Auto-Deductions: The system finds any advances taken in that period and subtracts them to show the 'Net Salary'.
• Payment: Clicking 'Pay and Save' marks advances as paid and archives the salary.
• Debt Rollover: If advances exceed the salary (negative net), the system will ask to roll over the remaining debt as a new advance for the following month.

suppliers.title: Suppliers & Debts
suppliers.content:
🎯 Purpose:
A precise digital ledger. Prevents lost invoices, tracks every penny owed or paid, and provides detailed statements for each supplier.

⚙️ Detailed Steps:
• Add Supplier: Create manually or import a full list via 'Excel'. You can add an 'Initial Debt' balance.
• Add Debt (Receipt): Open the supplier's profile, click 'Add Receipt', and enter the invoice amount to increase your debt.
• Pay Supplier: Click 'Add Payment' to register cash given to the supplier. You MUST specify which drawer the money came from (Admin or Cashier) so it balances their shift.
• Schedule: Schedule future payments to receive notifications in the Agenda.

expenses.title: Expenses & Advances
expenses.content:
🎯 Purpose:
Ensure no unexplained cash shortages. Any money leaving the drawer for non-inventory reasons must be recorded here to calculate true net profit.

⚙️ Detailed Steps:
• Add Expense: Select the source drawer, category (maintenance, utilities), enter the amount, and write a clear description.
• Staff Advance: If you select 'Staff Advance', you must specify the employee. This automatically sends the debt to the Payroll module for end-of-month deduction.
• Printing: Filter expenses by date or drawer and print comprehensive reports for accounting.

map.title: 3D Map & PDF Invoices
map.content:
🎯 Purpose:
The system's revolutionary feature. Digitize your physical store and automate data entry by letting the system read PDF invoices and route items to shelves.

⚙️ Detailed Steps:
• Build Map: Drag and drop shelves/fridges to design your store. Click a shelf to link it to a category (e.g., Cleaning Supplies).
• Set Active: Save the map and set it as the 'Active Layout'.
• Import PDF: Upload a supplier's delivery note (PDF). The system extracts barcodes and quantities.
• Auto-Routing: The system matches extracted items to your mapped shelves. Review the table, then click 'Save and Link' to inject hundreds of items into your inventory in seconds.

cashier_shift.title: Shift (Open & Close)
cashier_shift.content:
🎯 Purpose:
Protects you financially by separating your transactions from other cashiers, holding you accountable only for your shift's timeframe.

⚙️ Detailed Steps:
1. Open Shift: Count the actual cash in your drawer when you start, and enter it as 'Opening Balance' in the Register screen.
2. Sales: You cannot access the POS without an open shift.
3. Close Shift: At the end of your shift, click 'Close Shift'. Count your drawer's physical cash and enter it in 'Actual Cash'.
4. Notes: If there is a discrepancy (shortage/surplus) between your count and the system, write the reason in the notes.
5. Print: Your shift report will print automatically as proof of your shift's balance.

cashier_pos.title: Point of Sale (POS)
cashier_pos.content:
🎯 Purpose:
Your main workspace. Designed for speed and simplicity to serve customers efficiently.

⚙️ Detailed Steps:
1. Scan: Use the barcode scanner; items immediately appear in the cart.
2. Adjust: Click the quantity number in the cart to modify it.
3. Pay: Click 'Pay' to finalize the transaction, register the revenue, and print the customer ticket.
4. Cancel: You can delete individual items or clear the entire cart if the customer cancels the purchase.

cashier_expenses.title: Drawer Expenses
cashier_expenses.content:
🎯 Purpose:
Justify any cash taken out of your drawer. If you don't record it, your shift will show a cash shortage!

⚙️ Detailed Steps:
1. When to use: If the manager asks you to pay a supplier, pay a utility bill, or give an advance to a coworker from your drawer.
2. Record: Go to the 'Expenses' page and click 'Add Expense'.
3. Details: Choose the right category, enter the exact amount, and write a clear note.
4. Balance: The system will automatically subtract this from your expected drawer total.

cashier_attendance.title: Check In / Check Out
cashier_attendance.content:
🎯 Purpose:
Ensures your exact working hours are logged so your salary is calculated accurately without unfair deductions.

⚙️ Detailed Steps:
1. Quick Access: No matter what screen you are on, press (Ctrl + Shift + A) on your keyboard to instantly open the attendance popup.
2. Scan: Scan your ID badge barcode or type your PIN.
3. Confirm: Look for the green success message confirming your 'Check In' or 'Check Out'. Always verify this message!
